title: The kit policy of a composer.json
description: make layout-check (config/layout.kit.yml, lint-composer-policy) checks every composer.json against it (S2). No manifest maps classes by classmap or PSR-0. A library, the default type of Composer, loads its classes by PSR-4 and its tests by autoload-dev PSR-4; files stays allowed for namespaced functions and constants. A project (a consumer fixture) and a php-ext (an extension that PIE builds) hold no classes of their own.
